header: Here I check what the roster pages gave (ticket, name, department) against the HR directory, so that nothing wrong is stored as if it were right. A row is verified -- its ticket is an HR employee whose name fits (same phonetic words) and, when the fit is only partial, whose department fits too; corrected -- its ticket was misread or unknown, but exactly ONE HR employee has this name and this department: that ticket is used (noted); unverified -- anything else. Stored, flagged, never shown as confirmed; the ticket as read is kept for a person to look at. For the name comparison I use the directory's own phonetic codes (the same ones the name search uses), computed by the database.

symbols.name: squash
doc: I grade how well a printed name fits an HR name, by phonetic codes: exact : at least two codes in common, and every code of the shorter name is among them (SANJAY ROY = SANJAY RAY = S ROY ...) partial : every code of the shorter name matches, but there is only one ("P O ROY" against "PERE PADEN OUSEPH ROY"), or all but one word of a longer name matches (a first letter spoilt by a rule mark) none : otherwise

doc: Two spellings a letter or two apart ("AVUIT MAJI" / "AVIJIT MAJI", "RUB SAHA" / "RUBI SAHA", "DEBJIT DATTA" / "DEBJIT DUTTA"): an OCR slip or a spelling variant, not another person. This is weak evidence on its own, so I only use it together with the same ticket AND the same department code.
